situation: Quantizing the KV cache to save memory.
decision: FP8 KV cache can roughly halve memory, but calibration/scaling matters; do not assume a quantized KV cache is interchangeable between engines or model variants.
reasoning_physics: KV cache quant is calibration-sensitive — a scaling constant tuned for one engine/model yields silent attention error elsewhere. Halving memory is valuable but the cache is an engine-specific artifact, not a portable one.
